stem: Under what name was Pac-Man first released in Japan in 1980?
explanation: The name echoes paku-paku, Japanese for the sound of a mouth snapping open and shut. The American release was renamed because vandals could easily scratch the P on cabinets into another letter.

claims.text: Namco released Pac-Man in Japan in 1980 under the name Puck Man.
Pac-Man was not released in Japan as Chomp Man, Pizza Man or Munch Man.
The name Puck Man comes from the Japanese onomatopoeia paku-paku, for a mouth opening and closing as it eats.
The game was renamed Pac-Man for its American release because of fears that vandals would alter the P in Puck Man on arcade cabinets.
